required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Official application cover sheet signed by authorized organizational representative.

required_documents.name: Project Narrative / Technical Proposal
required_documents.details: Technical proposal addressing project background, work scope, technical methodology, milestones, and deliverables.

required_documents.name: Budget Justification and Line-Item Spreadsheet
required_documents.details: Detailed breakdown of proposed federal and non-federal cost share expenditures across personnel, equipment, supplies, and subcontracts.

required_documents.name: Summary for Public Release / Project Abstract
required_documents.details: One-page self-contained summary suitable for public release containing no confidential or proprietary information.

required_documents.name: Resumes of Key Personnel & Current/Pending Support
required_documents.details: Curriculum vitae or resumes of project director and key team members, along with federal current and pending support disclosures.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and Portal Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with UEI and authorized access to DOE submission portal (e.g. NEUP or EERE Exchange).

eligibility.summary: Eligible entities include higher education institutions, nonprofits, for-profit entities, or state/local government bodies as specified in the notice.

cost_share.details: Cost sharing is not required and is not an evaluation factor for this basic research announcement.

review_criteria.criterion: Technical Approach and Work Plan Feasibility

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided each application is scientifically and programmatically distinct.
important_notes: Applications must be submitted electronically through the designated portal prior to the deadline: see notice.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Ensure all project narrative and attachment page limits are strictly respected to avoid administrative rejection without review.
